_about: The year's anchors: the festivals, markets, series and seasons that come around every year. Hand-authored 2026-09-13 from the archived events notes; windows are month-day ranges (from/to, wrapping the year when to < from) and are approximate — most shift a few days each year, so verify the exact dates on the site before planning around one. weekday (optional, e.g. ["Thu"]) lets the page name the next date of a weekly series. The Anytime tab shows what is in season now and what starts within two months. The daily Action never writes this file.

anchors.name: Polar Plunge
anchors.note: New Year's Day into the lake. Watch or go in.

anchors.name: Gallery Night MKE
anchors.note: Quarterly: a Friday night and Saturday in January, April, July and October. Galleries open late.

anchors.name: Winter Farmers Market at the Domes
anchors.note: Saturday mornings in the Domes' annex, November to April. The market has changed venue before — confirm it is still at the Domes this winter.

anchors.name: St. Patrick's Day Parade
anchors.where: Downtown, Old World Third to Water St
anchors.note: The Saturday nearest the 17th.

anchors.name: Milwaukee Film Festival
anchors.note: Two weeks of films; the Oriental is the hub, a walk from home.

anchors.name: Bradford Beach season
anchors.note: Lifeguards, tiki bars and volleyball, Memorial Day to Labor Day.

anchors.name: County park beer gardens
anchors.where: Estabrook, Hubbard Park, South Shore, the Traveling Beer Garden
anchors.note: Estabrook and Hubbard Park are a walk or a short bike ride; the Traveling Beer Garden moves park to park.

anchors.name: Farmers markets
anchors.where: Shorewood (Sun), Riverwest Gardeners (Sun), South Shore (Sat), Tosa (Sat), Fondy (Sat)
anchors.note: Shorewood's Sunday market on Oakland is the walkable one; Riverwest's is a bike ride.

anchors.name: Jazz in the Park
anchors.note: Thursday evenings, free, bring a blanket.

anchors.name: River Rhythms
anchors.note: Wednesday evenings on the river, free.

anchors.name: Chill on the Hill
anchors.note: Tuesday evenings at the bandshell, free.

anchors.name: PrideFest Milwaukee
anchors.note: The first weekend of June on the Summerfest grounds.

anchors.name: Locust Street Festival
anchors.note: Riverwest's street party, the second Sunday of June; the beer run starts it.

anchors.name: Juneteenth Day
anchors.note: One of the oldest Juneteenth celebrations in the country: parade and street festival.

anchors.name: Summerfest
anchors.note: Three long weekends, a dozen stages. Admission deals most days.

anchors.name: Cedarburg Strawberry Festival
anchors.note: The last full weekend of June, twenty miles north.

anchors.name: Lakefront fireworks
anchors.note: July 3rd on the lakefront; a walk down through Lake Park. The lakefront show was paused for several years — confirm it is on this year.

anchors.name: Bastille Days
anchors.note: Four days of French Milwaukee with a 43-foot Eiffel Tower.

anchors.name: Festa Italiana
anchors.note: Check the year's format; it has moved and shrunk in recent years.

anchors.name: Brady Street Festival
anchors.note: The street closed for a Saturday of stages and food.

anchors.name: German Fest
anchors.note: The last full weekend of July.

anchors.name: Wisconsin State Fair
anchors.note: Eleven days; cream puffs; the bus from downtown runs straight there.

anchors.name: Milwaukee Irish Fest
anchors.note: The world's largest Irish festival, the third weekend of August.

anchors.name: Mexican Fiesta
anchors.note: The last of the summer festivals on the grounds.

anchors.name: Bay View Bash
anchors.note: A Saturday in mid-September, the street closed end to end.

anchors.name: Center Street Daze
anchors.note: Riverwest's September street festival; the art car race.

anchors.name: Doors Open Milwaukee
anchors.note: One weekend in late September when 150 buildings open their doors, free. Run by Historic Milwaukee; some tours need a ticket via Eventbrite.

anchors.name: Oktoberfest at Estabrook
anchors.note: Weekends of steins and brass at the beer garden on the river.

anchors.name: Cedarburg Wine & Harvest Festival
anchors.note: Third weekend of September; grape stomp.

anchors.name: Milwaukee Lakefront Marathon
anchors.note: First Sunday of October; the finish is on the lakefront.

anchors.name: Fall color at Holy Hill
anchors.note: The basilica above the trees; Kettle Moraine is the same drive.

anchors.name: Holiday Folk Fair International
anchors.note: The weekend before Thanksgiving: 50 cultures' food, dance and markets under one roof.

anchors.name: Milwaukee Holiday Lights Festival
anchors.where: Downtown parks and Pere Marquette Park
anchors.note: Kicks off the Thursday before Thanksgiving; the Jingle Bus tours the lights.

anchors.name: Christkindlmarket Milwaukee
anchors.note: The German-style market: glühwein in the boot mug.

anchors.name: Pabst Mansion at Christmas
anchors.note: The house dressed for the season; tours through the holidays.

anchors.name: Brewers home season
anchors.note: The games themselves are in the dated list; tailgating starts three hours before.

anchors.name: Bucks season
anchors.note: Their schedule feed blocks readers, so this is the reminder; the Deer District plaza is free on game nights.

anchors.name: Admirals season
anchors.note: Home games are in the dated list; cheap seats, downtown.

anchors.name: Marquette basketball
anchors.note: Big East games downtown from November.
